Name: Salome
Role: Disciple; Witness of the Crucifixion and Resurrection
Summary: Salome was one of the women who followed Jesus in Galilee, watched the crucifixion from afar, and came to the tomb on the first day of the week. Tradition identifies her as the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee.
KeyStory: Salome stood at a distance at the cross and came early to the tomb, and heard that He was risen.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary Magdalene; Mary, Mother of James and Joses; James, Son of Zebedee; John the Apostle
LifeLesson: Salome stayed when staying cost everything, and came early when hope was gone. Faithful presence is its own witness.
